discussions.title: `workspace-write`: pre-existing subdirectories are missing the Low mandatory label and the capability ACE

en.headline: 8 own commits plus 18 automated commits
en.summary: **8 own commits** were made in `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox`, plus 18 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]` in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`. The own commits expanded knowledge notes on plugin forms, minimal plugin composition, installation reconciliation, Profile and Preset analogies and boundaries, and the DSH Profile/Preset injection chain. They also added a quick reference for three plugin types and patch syntax, benchmark criteria, model routing, and the dollar-sign rendering issue in chat output. Two agent environment rules covered sandbox write troubleshooting and feasibility testing, while another note recorded the WARN review conclusion for a third-party diagnostic plugin. The user commented in the existing `deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness` discussion #11154, “`workspace-write`: pre-existing subdirectories are missing the Low mandatory label and the capability ACE”, which has 4 comments. No pull requests, issues, reviews, or releases were recorded.

zh.headline: 8 次本人提交，另有 18 次自动提交
zh.summary: 在 `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` 完成 **8 次本人提交**，另有 18 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 自动提交。本人提交扩充了知识笔记，涵盖插件形态、纯插件最小构成、安装对账分流，以及 Profile 与 Preset 的比喻和池子边界。还补全了 DSH Profile 与 Preset 注入链路、三类插件与 patch 语法速查、跑分口径、模型路由和聊天输出中的美元符号渲染问题。两条 agent 环境规则补充了沙箱写入排查与可行性实测，另有一条笔记记录第三方诊断插件的 WARN 评审结论。本人在 `deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness` 的既有讨论 #11154 “`workspace-write`: pre-existing subdirectories are missing the Low mandatory label and the capability ACE” 中发表评论，该讨论共 4 条评论。当天未记录拉取请求、issue、评审或发布。
